title: Crystal Orb Vision
description: A surreal black-background scene features a large transparent crystal orb containing a silhouetted figure with curly hair holding white lotus flowers against a glowing purple circle. Surrounding the orb are colorful stylized branches, floating faces, a red moon, starry space elements, purple lotus flowers at the base, and a small walking figure on a path.
prompt: Surreal fantasy artwork on black background showing a large transparent glowing crystal orb containing a silhouetted Black figure with curly hair in profile holding white lotus flowers, set against a vibrant purple circular backdrop inside the orb. Colorful stylized tree branches with faces and eyes extend around the orb, a red moon appears in the upper left, cosmic space elements with spirals and stars fill the top right, purple lotus flowers grow along the bottom path where a tiny walking figure appears, intricate line work with glowing yellow accents throughout.
